item.title: Do you share games with your friends?
item.author: invalid@example.com (Glio)
item.dc:creator: Glio
item.content:encoded: I was talking to a coworker about video games, and he was surprised that I didn't own Donkey Kong Bananza or Metroid Dread, given that I really like those games. I mentioned that a friend had lent them to me, and he said he didn't know anyone he could swap games with, well, now he does! It got me wondering: is it actually that unusual for adults to still lend games to each other, or is my coworker just unlucky?
